process_description: Returns all legal matters (workspaces) for the current legal user. Creates a new legal matter (workspace) with optional linked tenant. Creates a court filing record (docket entry) for a matter. Creates or updates a discovery request/response record for a matter. Assigns the next sequential exhibit number for a matter and records exhibit metadata.
